subject: MAP: Curation gate + ephemeral-use plan for evaluation assets
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@brightmart.com>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@brightmart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Curation gate + ephemeral-use plan for evaluation assets

Hi Lena / Jamal —

Great to meet on the call yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MPA) and a light manifest of the initial prompt pack + sample testcases we discussed. High-level asks from your side that we captured:

- Provide a ~2k-row curated testset and a 150-example prompt pack (CSV manifest attached).
- Access must be ephemeral: assets available only within an isolated sandbox for 14 days, no persistent storage beyond that window.
- No export of raw records; only model output and summary metrics allowed.

Proposed close timeline (subject to your security review):
- 09/03: Customer to deliver dataset + manifest to our secure upload (SFTP link in Drive).
- 09/04–09/06: Redwood runs canary ingestion + dry-run on a dedicated sandbox instance.
- 09/07: Joint QA review (30–45m) to validate prompt coverage and metric baseline.
- 09/10: Final acceptance and MPA signature (DocuSign link below).

Attached: redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf, promptpack_manifest.csv, testcase_sample.jsonl
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/RM-4593
DocuSign (MPA): https://app.docusign.com/sign/abc123

If those dates look tight, we can shift the canary window by a few days — but the 14-day ephemeral window is non-negotiable on BrightMart's side per last call.

Next steps: please confirm delivery method and SOC 2 evidence contact for security to validate. Happy to sync 15m tomorrow if that helps finalize the handoff.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Curation gate + ephemeral-use plan for evaluation assets

Evelyn —

Saw your draft. A few implementation clarifications from the ops side before we lock dates:

- Ephemeral access: we can provision dedicated sandbox creds scoped to 14 days and enforce auto-delete on the object store. Confirm: can BrightMart accept a temporary S3 presigned upload instead of SFTP? Presigned allows us to tag and enforce lifecycle rules.
- Retention: need confirmation whether BrightMart will permit Redwood to keep derived tokens and logs for 30 days for billing/debug only (we can redact PII). If not, we need to shorten our incident debugging window and add a QA checklist.
- Canary model: propose running on rwd-canon-small first (quantized) to reduce cost; if BrightMart wants higher-fidelity, we'll schedule a second pass on rwd-canon-medium.

Marissa — can you bucket the ingestion steps and estimate the engineering hours for the canary (include QA and metric baseline run)?

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Lena Park <lena@brightmart.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@brightmart.com>, BrightMart Security <security@brightmart.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Curation gate + ephemeral-use plan for evaluation assets

Thanks, Evelyn — and thanks for the clear timeline. Two quick clarifications from security and product:

> On Tue, 1 Sep 2026 at 09:15, Evelyn Hart wrote:
> > - Access must be ephemeral: assets available only within an isolated sandbox for 14 days, no persistent storage beyond that window.

We absolutely require the 14-day ephemeral window. Additional security asks:
- All uploads must be to a customer-dedicated bucket; Redwood should not mix our files with other customers.
- No model fine-tuning on our data. Inference-only access and audit logs proving no export of raw rows.
- Temporary accounts must be limited to specific IP ranges (we will provide).
- SOC 2 Type II report and a short runbook for incident response before ingest.

Regarding retention of derived logs: BrightMart can accept up to 7 days of system logs for debugging, not 30. Anything longer needs explicit approval from our compliance team.

We prefer presigned S3 upload. Please send the exact bucket name and a presigned-put workflow. Also please attach the SOC 2 link to the HubSpot deal.

Lena Park
Head of Product, BrightMart

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@brightmart.com>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@brightmart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, BrightMart Security <security@brightmart.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Curation gate + ephemeral-use plan for evaluation assets

Lena — thanks, understood. We can do everything you requested. Summary of confirmed constraints and how Redwood will enforce them: 

- Dedicated bucket: we'll create customer-dedicated S3 prefix (brightmart-rm-4593) and provide presigned PUT links. Upload window will be 09/03 08:00–09/03 20:00 PT.
- Ephemeral sandbox: objects will be auto-deleted at 14 days via lifecycle policy; we'll also run a delete job at 14d+2h as a safety.
- No fine-tuning: ingestion path will mark assets read-only and route them to inference-only sandboxes; engineering will disable any persistence hooks in the ingestion pipeline.
- IP restrictions: please send the list of allowed IPv4 ranges; we'll bind the temporary creds to those ranges.
- Logs: we can retain system logs (scrubbed of PII) for up to 7 days and expose an audit log bundle during the joint QA session.
- SOC 2: attaching a secure link to our SOC 2 evidence in the HubSpot deal; security can request an NDA-addendum if needed.

Revised close timeline (final):
- 09/03: Upload to presigned S3 (brightmart-rm-4593), provide notification to security@brightmart.com when done.
- 09/04–09/06: Run rwd-canon-small canary + baseline metrics.
- 09/07 10:00 PT: Joint QA (30m) — confirm metric baselines and export only summary CSV.
- 09/08: MPA signature and close (DocuSign link).

Attachments: redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf (updated with logged constraints), promptpack_manifest.csv, testcase_sample.jsonl
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/RM-4593 (SOC 2 link added)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sign/abc123

If that looks good I'll schedule the QA invite and send presigned links once you provide the IP ranges.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena@brightmart.com>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@brightmart.com>, BrightMart Security <security@brightmart.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Curation gate + ephemeral-use plan for evaluation assets

All — quick operational check from my side ahead of the upload:

- I'll own the presigned link creation and will post the three links (promptpack, testcases, bulk CSV) to the HubSpot deal page by 09/03 07:30 PT.
- Estimated engineer time for canary: 6 hours (ingestion + one metric run) + 2 hours QA. I'll allocate a canary slot on 09/04 14:00 PT.
- I'll generate the audit bundle and make it available in the shared Drive folder during the QA session.
- If BrightMart confirms IP ranges today, I can bind the presigned links to those ranges; otherwise I'll add a short expiration (12h) and we'll rely on the bucket prefix.

Final checklist before close: presigned links live, SOC2 link confirmed in HubSpot, DocuSign route ready. After signature we'll schedule a short retro to confirm deletion and deliver the final audit package.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: promptpack_manifest.csv (manifest), testcase_sample.jsonl (sample)
